name: Seed Range Noise (GTE, per-item reseed)
plain: Initial noise for SamplerCustomAdvanced in which batch item i is drawn from its own CPU generator seeded seed + i, or seed + batch_index[i] when the latent was sliced from a batch. Each item's noise therefore matches a batch-size-1 run at that seed; core instead draws one tensor from one generator and slices it. The pack notes that re-running one item alone still gives a slightly different image, because GPU kernels change with batch size. Nested latents are refused.
math:
seedᵢ = seed + i, or seed + batch_index[i].
εᵢ = randn(1×C×H×W, CPU generator(seedᵢ)); ε = concatᵢ εᵢ, cast to the latent dtype.
